fields.quoted_span:
(b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates
or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
fields.note: Both prohibitions, the algorithmic device and nonpublic competitor data definitions, separate-violation rule and remedies all match the draft text. The statement that the nonpublic competitor data definition covers 'supply' is a fair paraphrase of 'residential rental property supply levels'.

fields.quoted_span:
A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to
$1,000 per violation of this Division, in a civil action against a landlord.
fields.note: The $1,000 per violation cap, the per-month and per-property separate violations, and the fee-shifting for prevailing tenants are all stated in §§ 98.1103 and 98.1104.
The effective_date field is empty. The document gives only a formula (30th day after final passage) and leaves the passage date blank, so it states no fixed date.

fields.quoted_span:
This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from
and after its final passage.
fields.note: The document is only a pre-adoption draft: the ordinance number, final passage date and adoption certificate are blank. It does not show that the ordinance was enacted or is in force. The in_force status rests on the secondary source, which is not in this document.

fields.quoted_span:
Residential rental property has the same meaning as in San Diego Municipal
Code section 98.0702, as may be amended.
fields.note: Incorporation of the § 98.0702 definitions for landlord, lease, residential rental property and tenant is supported. The document states no unit-count, age or owner-occupancy limits. The definition of residential rental property as a dwelling intended for human habitation, the content of § 98.0702, the § 98.0703 exemptions and their limitation to Division 7 are not in this document. Citywide scope follows from the draft's text and the staff report's 'Citywide'.

fields.quoted_span: §98.1103  Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
fields.note: The section and the division are confirmed, along with the O-2025-107 draft number, the §§ 98.1101–98.1104 range and the ordinance title. The ordinance number and the 'San Diego Mun. Code' form are not in the document.
